title: betula rugosa
intro: Betula rugosa, commonly known as paper birch or red birch, is a deciduous tree species native to eastern Asia. The health benefits of Betula rugosa include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms of the common cold. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as a natural antiseptic and astringent, making it effective in treating wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Betula rugosa include betulin, betulinic acid, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
